meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索历史记忆，找出之前会话的解法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从过往会话中找回解法与结论
copy.tagline_en: Search past sessions for prior solutions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to dig up past session solutions and decisions

howto.what: 装上后,当你问起以前做过的事,Claude 会搜索 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库。它先给出带编号的结果清单,需要时可再给时间线;你选定条目后,它才读取这些记录的完整内容。
howto.when: 当你提起之前会话里处理过的事时触发,比如「我们上次解决过这问题吗」「上次是怎么做 X 的」「上周发生了什么」。

say.text: 上次我们是不是已经解决过这个报错?
say.note: 触发搜索旧记录,返回带编号的索引表。

say.text: 查一下上周的会话记录,做了什么变更。
say.note: 按日期范围检索,可展示相关时间线。

say.text: 把过去关于登录认证的讨论翻出来。
say.note: 按关键词筛选旧记录,列出命中的索引。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask about past work, Claude searches claude-mem's cross-session memory. It first returns an indexed list of hits, can show a timeline when needed, and reads full details only for entries you select.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about previous sessions, e.g. did we already fix this, how did we solve X last time, or what happened last week.

say_en.text: Did we already solve this error last time?
say_en.note: Triggers a search through old sessions.

say_en.text: Look up last week's sessions and what changed.
say_en.note: Filters by date range and can show a timeline.

say_en.text: Find past discussions about login authentication.
say_en.note: Searches by keyword and lists matching old records.
